<!DOCTYPE html>
<html dir="rtl" lang="ar">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">

  
      <style type="text/css">
      /* =============================================================
   THEME META & ROOT (Vanilla)
   ============================================================= */
/*
Theme Name: Anime4up
Theme URL: https://vnxweb.com/
Version: 1.0
Author: vnxweb.com
Author URI: https://vnxweb.com/
Text Domain: vnxweb.com
This Theme Designed By vnxweb.com
*/

:root {
	/* Colors */
	--main-bg-color: #131722;
	--light-color: #8f8d8d;
	--red-color: #d41616;
	--red-color2: #aa0c0c;
	--yellow-color: #fbbd48;
	--bg-white: #fafafa;
	--blue-color: #029dbc;
	--text: #fff;

	/* Radii / Shadows / Motion */
	--radius: 8px;
	--shadow-sm: 0 1px 8px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, .06);
	--elev-inset: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .29);
	--ease: cubic-bezier(.2, .6, .2, 1);
	--dur: .2s;

	/* Layout */
	--container: 1200px;
	--gutter: 15px;

	--back-color-1: #181d2b;

}

/* =============================================================
   FONTS
   ============================================================= */
@font-face {
	font-family: 'DroidKufi-Regular';
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: 400;
	font-display: swap;
	/* 👈 مهم */
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.eot');
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.eot?#iefix') format('embedded-opentype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.woff2') format('woff2'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.woff') format('woff'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.ttf') format('truetype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/DroidKufi-Regular.svg#DroidKufi-Regular') format('svg');
}

@font-face {
	font-family: 'NeoSansArabic-Bold';
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: 700;
	font-display: swap;
	/* 👈 */
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.eot');
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.eot?#iefix') format('embedded-opentype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.woff2') format('woff2'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.woff') format('woff'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.ttf') format('truetype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic-Bold.svg#NeoSansArabic-Bold') format('svg');
}

@font-face {
	font-family: 'NeoSansArabic';
	font-style: normal;
	font-weight: 400;
	font-display: swap;
	/* 👈 */
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.eot');
	src: url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.eot?#iefix') format('embedded-opentype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.woff2') format('woff2'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.woff') format('woff'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.ttf') format('truetype'),
		url('https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/UI//Assets/fonts/NeoSansArabic.svg#NeoSansArabic') format('svg');
}


/* =============================================================
   RESET / BASE
   ============================================================= */
*,
*::before,
*::after {
	box-sizing: border-box;
}

html {
	-webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
	scroll-behavior: smooth;
}

body {
	font-family: DroidKufi-Regular, Arial, sans-serif;
	line-height: 1.428571429;
	color: #dddfe4;
	background: var(--main-bg-color);
	-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
	overflow-x: hidden;
}

* {
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

[dir="rtl"] body {
	direction: rtl;
}

a {
	color: #009ec0;
	text-decoration: none;
	outline: 0;
	transition: color var(--dur) var(--ease);
	font-size: 14px;
	-webkit-transition: all .2s ease-in-out 0s;
	-moz-transition: all .2s ease-in-out 0s;
	-o-transition: all .2s ease-in-out 0s;
	-ms-transition: all .2s ease-in-out 0s;
	transition: all .2s ease-in-out 0s;
}

a:focus,
a:hover {
	outline: 0 !important;
	text-decoration: none;
	color: #006075;
}

input,
textarea,
button,
select {
	font: inherit;
	border: 0;
	outline: 0;
	background: none;
	color: inherit;
}

textarea:focus,
input:focus {
	outline: none;
}

em {
	font-style: normal;
}

ul,
ol,
li {
	list-style: none;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

h1 {
	font-size: 2em;
	font-weight: 700;
}

h1,
h2,
h3,
h4,
h5,
h6,
.h1,
.h2,
.h3,
.h4,
.h5,
.h6 {
	font-family: inherit;
	font-weight: 500;
	line-height: 1.1;
	color: inherit;
}

h3 {
	font-size: 24px;
}

:focus-visible {
	outline: 2px solid var(--blue-color);
	outline-offset: 2px;
	border-radius: 6px;
}

/* Scrollbar */
*::-webkit-scrollbar {
	width: 10px;
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
	border: 1px solid var(--main-bg-color);
	background: var(--main-bg-color);
}

*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
	border-radius: 10px;
	box-shadow: inset 0 0 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .3);
	background: var(--blue-color);
	border: 1px solid var(--main-bg-color);
}

.main-widget {
	overflow: hidden;
}

.anime-card-themex {
	overflow: hidden;
}

.anime-card-poster{
	overflow: hidden;
}

.anime-card-poster img{
	width: 100%;
	height: 100%;
	object-fit: cover;
	display: block;
}

/* Helpers */
.clearfix::after {
	content: "";
	display: block;
	clear: both;
}

.imgInit {
	opacity: 0;
	transition: .35s all ease;
}

.imgInit.Loaded {
	opacity: 1;
}

.Slider--pind {

	overflow: hidden;
}

.item {
	overflow: hidden;
}

/* =============================================================
   CONTAINER / LAYOUT (Vanilla)
   ============================================================= */
.container {
	width: 100%;
	max-width: var(--container);
	margin-right: auto;
	margin-left: auto;
	padding-right: var(--gutter);
	padding-left: var(--gutter);
}

@media (max-width:1199.98px) {
	:root {
		--container: 970px;
	}
}

@media (max-width:991.98px) {
	:root {
		--container: 750px;
	}
}

@media (max-width:767.98px) {
	:root {
		--container: 100%;
	}
}


/* =============================================================
   HEADER / NAV (no Bootstrap)
   ============================================================= */
header {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 99;
	color: #0a0d14;
	background: #fff;
	box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
}

.header-navbar-container {
	position: relative;
}

.header-container {
	margin: 0 auto;
	display: grid;
	grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto;
	align-items: center;
	padding: 0 !important;
}

.site-branding {
	padding-inline: 35px 25px;
	min-height: 1px;
}

.site-logo {
	vertical-align: middle;
}

.main-navigation {
	justify-self: start;
}

.main-menu {
	display: flex;
	gap: 6px;
}

.main-menu>li {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 100;
}

.main-menu>li>a {
	display: block;
	padding: 23px 6px;
	font-size: 14px;
	color: #1e1e1e;
	font-family: NeoSansArabic-Bold, Arial, sans-serif;
}


.main-menu li a:hover,
.main-menu li:hover>a {
	background-color: #f5f5f5;
	color: #1e1e1e;
}

.header-tools {
	width: 160px;
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 6px;
	justify-content: center;
}

.header-tools i {
	display: inline-grid;
	place-items: center;
	width: 40px;
	height: 40px;
	border-radius: 50%;
	background: #f0f0f0;
	color: #1e1e1e;
	font-size: 14px;
	cursor: pointer;
}

.NoSearchResults img {
	max-width: 200px;
}

/* =============================================================
   SEARCH HEAD (toggle with .open)
   ============================================================= */
.SearchHead {
	position: absolute;
	top: 100%;
	z-index: 1111;
	background: var(--main-bg-color);
	color: var(--text);
	box-shadow: var(--elev-inset);
	opacity: 0;
	visibility: hidden;
	border-radius: 4px;
	transform: translateY(-8px);
	transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease), transform var(--dur) var(--ease), visibility 0s linear var(--dur);
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
}

.SearchHead.open {
	opacity: 1;
	visibility: visible;
	transform: translateY(0);
	transition-delay: 0s;
}

.SearchHead form input[type="text"] {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: 40px;
	padding: 0 10px 0 16px;
	font-size: 16px;
	color: #949cb0;
	background-color: #141824;
	border: 1px solid #262d40;
}

#hideSearch {
	background-color: var(--back-color-1);
}

#hideSearch {
	cursor: pointer;
	font-family: NeoSansArabic-Bold, Arial, sans-serif;
	color: var(--text);
	padding: 20px 15px;
	text-align: center;
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 0.4vw;
}

.SearchHead form {
	padding: 11px;
	width: 100%;
}

.SearchHead form :focus {
	border-color: #394155;
	box-shadow: inset 0 1px 1px rgb(34, 39, 52), 0 0 8px rgb(34, 39, 52);
}

/* الوضع العادي */
input::placeholder,
textarea::placeholder {
	transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

/* عند الفوكس */
input:focus::placeholder,
textarea:focus::placeholder {
	color: var(--text);
	/* اللون اللي انت عايزه عند الفوكس */
}

.SearchHead .icon,
.SearchHead button {
	position: absolute;
	top: 50%;
	left: 10px;
	width: 40px;
	height: 34px;
	line-height: 35px;
	font-size: 14px;
	cursor: pointer;
	transform: translateY(-50%);
	color: var(--text);
	background-color: #009ec0;
	border: 1px solid transparent !important;
	border-color: #ccc;
}

.Close--SearchingBox {
	position: absolute !important;
	top: 10px;
	left: 13px;
	width: 38px;
	height: 38px;
	line-height: 40px;
	text-align: center;
	font-size: 22px;
	color: #0e1331;
	border-radius: 8px;
}

/* Fullscreen search result overlay */
.SearchListResult {
	position: fixed;
	inset: 0;
	z-index: 150;
	background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .75);
	opacity: 0;
	transform: scale(.98);
	visibility: hidden;
	transition: opacity var(--dur) var(--ease), transform var(--dur) var(--ease), visibility 0s linear var(--dur);
}

.SearchListResult.show {
	opacity: 1;
	transform: scale(1);
	visibility: visible;
	transition-delay: 0s;
}

.SearchListResult .loader {
	display: table;
	margin: 120px auto;
	transform: scale(1);
}

.SearchListResult h5 {
	height: 40px;
	padding: 5px 18px;
	margin-bottom: 10px;
	font-size: 16px;
	font-weight: 700;
	color: var(--text);
	border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .1);
	text-align: right;
}

.SearchListResult a {
	color: var(--text);
}

.SearchListResult .SearchInnerList {
	height: calc(100% - 60px);
	margin: 0 300px;
	background: var(--main-bg-color);
	position: relative;
	overflow: auto;
	padding: 16px 20px;
	overscroll-behavior: contain;
	text-align: center;
}

@media (max-width:1199.98px) {
	.SearchListResult .SearchInnerList {
		margin: 0 120px;
	}
}

@media (max-width:767.98px) {
	.SearchListResult .SearchInnerList {
		margin: 0 16px;
	}
}

a.SearchListMoreButton {
	font-family: NeoSansArabic-Bold, Arial, sans-serif;
	border-radius: 101px;
	border: 0;
	color: var(--main-bg-color);
	background-color: var(--text);
	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 1.2vw;
	width: 170px;
	justify-content: center;
	padding: 12px;
	font-size: 16px;
	margin-top: 20px;
}

a.SearchListMoreButton:hover {
	color: #009ec0;
}

.SearchInnerList>li {
	display: inline-block;
	width: 100%;
	margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchThumb {
	width: 60px;
	height: 70px;
	float: right;
	overflow: hidden;
	border: 2px solid var(--blue-color);
	box-shadow: 0 2px 12px #0000005c;
}


.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner {
	float: left;
	width: calc(100% - 75px);
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner .Stars {
	font-size: 10px;
	margin-bottom: 3px;
	position: relative;
	color: #00000033;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner .Stars .Front {
	position: absolute;
	inset: auto 0 0 0;
	width: 100%;
	height: 100%;
	color: #ffb659;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner>h1 {
	font-size: 14px;
	margin-bottom: 4px;
	font-weight: 700;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner>ul {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 10px;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner>ul>li {
	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: 700;
	background: linear-gradient(to left, var(--blue-color), transparent);
	height: 20px;
	padding: 5px 8px;
	border-radius: 3px;
	line-height: 14px;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner>ul>li>span {
	color: var(--bg-white);
	margin-left: 8px;
	line-height: 100%;
}

.SearchInnerList>li .SearchResultInner>ul>li a {
	color: #FFC107;
	font-size: 12px;
	position: relative;
	bottom: 1px;
}

.NoSearchResults {
	margin: 103px auto;
	color: var(--text);
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 17px;
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	align-items: center;
}

/* ثابت/مخفي عند اللزوم */
.search--userarea--rightbar {
	display: block;
	position: relative;
	margin: 0 -8px 0;
}

.search--userarea--rightbar input {
	display: block;
	width: 100%;
	height: 60px;
	border: 0;
	border-radius: var(--radius);
	padding: 0 26px;
	font-size: 16px;
	background: #fff;
	color: #0e1331;
}

.search--userarea--rightbar>button {
	display: none;
}

.SearchHead.SearchFixed {
	display: none;
}

/* =============================================================
   BREADCRUMBS / BLOCKS / PAGINATION
   ============================================================= */
#my-breadcrumbs {
	margin: 0 -6px 10px;
	line-height: 22px;
	white-space: nowrap;
	overflow: hidden;
	text-overflow: ellipsis;
}

#my-breadcrumbs>* {
	display: inline-block;
	vertical-align: middle;
	color: var(--blue-color);
	padding: 0 6px;
	font-size: 15px;
}

#my-breadcrumbs a {
    color: #01a5c2;
    line-height: 100%;
    font-size: 17px;
}

.BlocksHolder {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 10px;
	margin: 0 -5px;
	padding-bottom: 10px;
}

.pagination {
	display: table;
	margin: 20px auto;
	border-radius: 50px;
}

.pagination .page-numbers {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: 6px;
}

.pagination li {
	padding: 0 3px;
}

.pagination>ul>li>* {
	display: block;
	padding: 11px 15px;
	font-size: 18px;
	line-height: 100%;
	background: #232a41;
	border-radius: 5px;
	color: var(--text)
}

.pagination>ul>li>span.current {
	background: var(--blue-color) !important;
	color: var(--text);
}

/* =============================================================
   LOADER (chase)
   ============================================================= */
.sk-chase {
	width: 40px;
	height: 40px;
	position: relative;
	animation: sk-chase 2.5s infinite linear both;
}

.sk-chase-dot {
	width: 100%;
	height: 100%;
	position: absolute;
	left: 0;
	top: 0;
	animation: sk-chase-dot 2s infinite ease-in-out both;
}

.sk-chase-dot:before {
	content: "";
	display: block;
	width: 25%;
	height: 25%;
	background: #009ec0;
	border-radius: 100%;
	animation: sk-chase-dot-before 2s infinite ease-in-out both;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(1) {
	animation-delay: -1.1s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(2) {
	animation-delay: -1s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(3) {
	animation-delay: -.9s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(4) {
	animation-delay: -.8s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(5) {
	animation-delay: -.7s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(6) {
	animation-delay: -.6s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(1):before {
	animation-delay: -1.1s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(2):before {
	animation-delay: -1s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(3):before {
	animation-delay: -.9s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(4):before {
	animation-delay: -.8s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(5):before {
	animation-delay: -.7s;
}

.sk-chase-dot:nth-child(6):before {
	animation-delay: -.6s;
}

@keyframes sk-chase {
	100% {
		transform: rotate(360deg);
	}
}

@keyframes sk-chase-dot {

	80%,
	100% {
		transform: rotate(360deg);
	}
}

@keyframes sk-chase-dot-before {
	50% {
		transform: scale(.4);
	}

	100%,
	0% {
		transform: scale(1);
	}
}

/* =============================================================
   ACCESSIBILITY / MOTION
   ============================================================= */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

	*,
	*::before,
	*::after {
		animation: none !important;
		transition: none !important;
		scroll-behavior: auto !important;
	}
}

/* =============================================================
  Footer
   ============================================================= */
/* ========== Footer (Vanilla) ========== */
.site-footer {
	background-color: #0a0d14;
	color: var(--text);
	font-size: 14px;
	padding-bottom: 2rem;
}

.site-footer a {
	color: #e6e8ff;
}

audio,
canvas,
embed,
iframe,
object,
svg,
video {
	display: inline-block;
}

.site-footer svg {
	vertical-align: middle;
}

svg:not(:root) {
	overflow: hidden;
}

.scrollup .up {
	color: #d4d4d4;
}

.scrollup {
	text-align: center;
	margin-bottom: 10px;
	display: block;
}

.scrollup path {
	fill: var(--back-color-1);
}

.footer-row {
	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	font-size: 12px;
	justify-content: space-between;
}

.mt30 {
	margin-top: 10px;
}

.mb30 {
	margin-bottom: 30px;
}

hr {
	display: block;
	height: 1px;
	opacity: 0.25;
	background-color: var(--text);
	margin: 0;
	overflow: visible;
}

.footer-menu a:hover,
.copyrights a:hover {
	color: #0b9bb6;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
	.footer-row {
		text-align: center;
		flex-direction: column;
	}

}

.footer-col {
	min-width: 0;
}

.site-copyrights p,
.footer-links p {
	margin: 0;
}

.footer-social {
	display: flex;
	justify-content: center;
	align-items: center;
	gap: 0px;
	padding: 0;
	margin: 0;
}

.footer-social li {
	list-style: none;
}

.footer-social a {
	display: inline-grid;
	place-items: center;
	width: 40px;
	height: 40px;
	transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
	color: #fff;
	padding: 4px 9px;
	text-align: center;
	font-weight: 700;
	font-size: 16pt;
	border-radius: 20px;
}


svg {
	fill: var(--text)
}


.footer-social li a:hover i {

/* =========================
   Anime Cards
========================= */

/* الكارت */
.pinned-card {
	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	position: relative;
	background: transparent;
	padding: 0;
	border-radius: 14px;
	overflow: hidden;
	transition: transform .25s ease, box-shadow .25s ease;
}

/* Hover */
.pinned-card:hover {
	transform: translateY(-4px);
}

/* الصورة */
.pinned-card .image {
	width: 100%;
	position: relative;
	overflow: hidden;
	border-radius: 14px;

	/* نسبة موحدة لكل الصور */
	aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;

	background-size: cover;
	background-position: center top;
	background-repeat: no-repeat;

	background-color: #111827;
}

/* Gradient */
.pinned-card .image::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;
	background: linear-gradient(
		to top,
		rgba(0,0,0,.88) 0%,
		rgba(0,0,0,.45) 35%,
		rgba(0,0,0,0) 70%
	);
	pointer-events: none;
}










/* طبقة الهوفر */
.pinned-card .play-overlay {
	position: absolute;
	inset: 0;

	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;

	background-color: rgba(19, 23, 34, 0.45);

	opacity: 0;
	transition: opacity .25s ease;

	z-index: 5;
}

/* زر التشغيل */
.pinned-card .play-overlay i {
	width: 58px;
	height: 58px;

	display: flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;

	border-radius: 50%;

	background: rgba(255,255,255,.15);
	backdrop-filter: blur(5px);

	color: #fff;
	font-size: 22px;

	border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35);

	transform: scale(.85);
	transition: all .25s ease;
}

/* عند المرور */
.pinned-card:hover .play-overlay {
	opacity: 1;
}

.pinned-card:hover .play-overlay i {
	transform: scale(1);
	background: rgba(2,148,178,.9);
	border-color: rgba(255,255,255,.7);
}







/* الوضع الصباحي */
body.dark .pinned-card .image::after {
	background: linear-gradient(
		to top,
		rgb(2 148 178) 0%,
		transparent 50%,
		transparent 100%
	);
}

/* جديد */
.pinned-card .new-episode {
	position: absolute;
	top: 10px;
	right: 10px;
	background: #7f5af0;
	color: #fff;
	font-size: 11px;
	font-weight: bold;
	padding: 4px 8px;
	border-radius: 6px;
	z-index: 3;
	line-height: 1.2;
}

/* نوع الأنمي */
.pinned-card .anime-type-badge {
	position: absolute;
	top: 10px;
	left: 10px;

	background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffb84d, #ff8800);

	color: #000;
	font-size: 11px;
	padding: 4px 8px;
	border-radius: 6px;
	font-weight: bold;
	z-index: 3;
}

/* المعلومات */
.pinned-card .info {
	position: absolute;
	right: 0;
	left: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	z-index: 2;

	display: flex;
	flex-direction: column;
	gap: 6px;

	padding: 12px;
}

/* العنوان */
.pinned-card .info h3 {
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    margin: 0;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 2;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    word-break: break-word;
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    text-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, .7);
    min-height: calc(1.5em * 2);
}

/* روابط */
.pinned-card .info a {
	text-decoration: none;
	color: inherit;
}

/* المعلومات الصغيرة */
.pinned-card .search-statics {
	display: flex;
	gap: 6px;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	order: 1;
}

/* البادجات */
.pinned-card .search-statics span {
	background: rgba(19, 23, 34, 0.72);
	backdrop-filter: blur(4px);

	padding: 4px 7px;
	border-radius: 6px;

	font-size: 11px;
	line-height: 1.2;
	color: #fff;
}

/* زر الحلقة */
.pinned-card .badge.light-soft {
	order: 2;

	background: #131722;
	color: #fff;

	padding: 5px 9px;
	font-size: 12px;

	border-radius: 7px;

	display: inline-flex;
	align-items: center;
	justify-content: center;

	width: fit-content;

	margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* العنوان آخر شيء */
.pinned-card .info > a:first-child {
	order: 3;
}

========================= */

.themexblock {
	width: 20%;

/* =============================================================
   Header menu icons RTL fix - الأيقونات في اليمين
   ============================================================= */

/* إلغاء الأيقونات القديمة التي كانت تظهر في الشمال */
.main-menu > li > a::after {
    content: none !important;
    display: none !important;
}

/* ترتيب الرابط: أيقونة يمين + نص */
.main-menu > li > a {
    display: flex !important;
    flex-direction: row !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    gap: 8px !important;
    white-space: nowrap;
    direction: rtl;
}

/* الأيقونة في اليمين */
.main-menu > li > a::before {
    font-family: "Font Awesome 6 Free";
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: 17px;
    color: #4b5563;
    line-height: 1;
    display: inline-block;
}

/* الرئيسية */
.main-menu > li.menu-home > a::before {
    content: "\f015";
}

/* قائمة الأنمي */
.main-menu > li.menu-anime-list > a::before {
    content: "\f04b";
}

/* أفلام الأنمي */
.main-menu > li.menu-anime-movies > a::before {
    content: "\f008";
}

/* ربيع 2026 */
.main-menu > li.menu-spring-2026 > a::before {
    content: "\f073";
}

/* المنتدى */
.main-menu > li.menu-forum > a::before {
    content: "\f086";
}

/* مواعيد الحلقات */
.main-menu > li.menu-schedule > a::before {
    content: "\f073";
}

/* اتصل بنا */
.main-menu > li.menu-contact > a::before {
    content: "\f0e0";
}

/* لون العنصر النشط */
.main-menu > li.current-menu-item > a,
.main-menu > li.current_page_item > a,
.main-menu > li.current-menu-ancestor > a {
    color: #5b35ff !important;
}

/* لون أيقونة العنصر النشط */
.main-menu > li.current-menu-item > a::before,
.main-menu > li.current_page_item > a::before,
.main-menu > li.current-menu-ancestor > a::before {
    color: #5b35ff !important;
}

/* تحسين القائمة في الهاتف */
@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
    #mobile-nav .main-menu > li > a {
        justify-content: flex-start !important;
        direction: rtl;
        gap: 10px !important;
    }

    #mobile-nav .main-menu > li > a::before {
        width: 22px;
        min-width: 22px;
        text-align: center;
        color: #9ca3af;
    }

    #mobile-nav .main-menu > li.current-menu-item > a::before,
    #mobile-nav .main-menu > li.current_page_item > a::before {
        color: #05d3e7 !important;
    }
}


/* =============================================================
   MAIN SECTION TITLE - محسّن ومتوافق مع الوضع الليلي/الصباحي
   ملاحظة: الوضع الافتراضي في القالب = ليلي، و body.dark عندك = صباحي/فاتح.
   ============================================================= */

.main-section:not(.search-content) {
	position: relative;
	text-align: center;
	padding: 24px 0;
	margin: 0;
	color: var(--text);
	background: var(--back-color-1);
	border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .04);
	border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(45, 53, 74, .85);
	-webkit-box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .29);
	-moz-box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .29);
	box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .29);
	overflow: hidden;
}

.main-section:not(.search-content)::after {
	content: "";
	position: absolute;
	right: 0;
	left: 0;
	bottom: 0;
	height: 2px;
	background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--blue-color), transparent);
	opacity: .75;
	pointer-events: none;
}

.main-section:not(.search-content) .container {
	position: relative;
	z-index: 2;
}

.main-section:not(.search-content) h1,
.main-section:not(.search-content) h2,
.main-section:not(.search-content) h3,
.main-section:not(.search-content) .search-page-title,
.main-section:not(.search-content) .episode-archive-title {
	margin: 0;
	padding: 0 10px;
	color: inherit;
	font-family: NeoSansArabic-Bold, DroidKufi-Regular, Arial, sans-serif;
	font-size: 22px;
	font-weight: 700;
	line-height: 1.8;
	text-align: center;
	text-shadow: none;
}

.main-section:not(.search-content) h1 span,
.main-section:not(.search-content) h2 span,
.main-section:not(.search-content) h3 span,
.main-section:not(.search-content) .search-page-title span,
.main-section:not(.search-content) .episode-archive-title span {
	color: var(--blue-color);
}

.main-section:not(.search-content) a {
	color: inherit;
	font-size: inherit;
}

.main-section:not(.search-content) a:hover {
	color: var(--blue-color);
}

/* الوضع الصباحي / الفاتح */
body.dark .main-section:not(.search-content) {
	color: #1c1e20;
	background: #ffffff;
	border-top-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, .04);
	border-bottom-color: #e5e7ee;
	-webkit-box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
	-moz-box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
	box-shadow: inset 0 6px 8px -7px rgba(0, 0, 0, .18);
}

body.dark .main-section:not(.search-content)::after {
	background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #029dbc, transparent);
	opacity: .7;
}

/* الموبايل */
@media (max-width: 767px) {
	.main-section:not(.search-content) {
		padding: 18px 0;
	}

	.main-section:not(.search-content) h1,
	.main-section:not(.search-content) h2,
	.main-section:not(.search-content) h3,
	.main-section:not(.search-content) .search-page-title,
	.main-section:not(.search-content) .episode-archive-title {
		font-size: 18px;
		line-height: 1.9;
		padding: 0 8px;
	}
}

<script>
(function () {
    var searchInput = document.getElementById('inputEpisode');
    var list        = document.getElementById('episodesList');
    var statusBox   = document.getElementById('episodesSearchStatus');

    var searchTimer = null;
    var searchAbort = null;
    var searchActive = false;

    var normalListHTML = list ? list.innerHTML : '';
    var normalLoadMoreHTML = '';
    var normalPaginationHTML = '';

    function getLoadMoreWrap() {
        return document.querySelector('.episodes-load-more-wrap');
    }

    function getPagination() {
        return document.querySelector('.episodes-pagination-holder');
    }

    function refreshNormalSnapshot() {
        if (searchActive || !list) {
            return;
        }

        normalListHTML = list.innerHTML;

        var loadWrap = getLoadMoreWrap();
        var pagination = getPagination();

        normalLoadMoreHTML = loadWrap ? loadWrap.outerHTML : '';
        normalPaginationHTML = pagination ? pagination.outerHTML : '';
    }

    function setStatus(message, type) {
        if (!statusBox) {
            return;
        }

        statusBox.textContent = message || '';
        statusBox.classList.remove('is-loading', 'is-error', 'is-success');

        if (type) {
            statusBox.classList.add(type);
        }
    }

    function waLoadImages(scope) {
        scope = scope || document;

        scope.querySelectorAll('img.imgInit[data-image]').forEach(function (img) {
            if (!img.getAttribute('src')) {
                img.setAttribute('src', img.getAttribute('data-image'));
            }
            img.classList.add('Loaded');
        });
    }

    function hidePagingControls() {
        var loadWrap = getLoadMoreWrap();
        var pagination = getPagination();

        if (loadWrap) {
            loadWrap.style.display = 'none';
        }
        if (pagination) {
            pagination.style.display = 'none';
        }
    }

    function restorePagingControls() {
        var body = document.querySelector('.main-widget-body');
        var loadWrap = getLoadMoreWrap();
        var pagination = getPagination();

        if (!body) {
            return;
        }

        if (!loadWrap && normalLoadMoreHTML) {
            var tmpLoad = document.createElement('div');
            tmpLoad.innerHTML = normalLoadMoreHTML;
            body.appendChild(tmpLoad.firstElementChild);
        } else if (loadWrap) {
            loadWrap.style.display = '';
        }

        if (!pagination && normalPaginationHTML) {
            var tmpPag = document.createElement('div');
            tmpPag.innerHTML = normalPaginationHTML;
            body.appendChild(tmpPag.firstElementChild);
        } else if (pagination) {
            pagination.style.display = '';
        }
    }

    function restoreNormalEpisodes() {
        if (!list) {
            return;
        }

        if (searchAbort) {
            searchAbort.abort();
            searchAbort = null;
        }

        searchActive = false;
        list.innerHTML = normalListHTML;
        restorePagingControls();
        setStatus('', '');
        waLoadImages(list);
    }

    function runAjaxSearch(query) {
        if (!searchInput || !list) {
            return;
        }

        if (searchAbort) {
            searchAbort.abort();
        }

        searchAbort = new AbortController();
        searchActive = true;
        hidePagingControls();
        setStatus('جاري البحث في كل حلقات هذا الأنمي...', 'is-loading');

        var form = new FormData();
        form.append('action', 'wa_episode_ajax_search');
        form.append('nonce', searchInput.getAttribute('data-nonce') || '');
        form.append('term_id', searchInput.getAttribute('data-term-id') || '0');
        form.append('order', searchInput.getAttribute('data-order') || 'desc');
        form.append('q', query);

        fetch(searchInput.getAttribute('data-ajax-url') || '', {
            method: 'POST',
            credentials: 'same-origin',
            body: form,
            signal: searchAbort.signal
        })
        .then(function (response) {
            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error('Request failed');
            }
            return response.json();
        })
        .then(function (json) {
            if (!json || !json.success || !json.data) {
                throw new Error('Bad response');
            }

            list.innerHTML = json.data.html || '';
            waLoadImages(list);

            if (json.data.count && parseInt(json.data.count, 10) > 0) {
                var text = 'تم العثور على ' + json.data.count + ' نتيجة';
                if (json.data.limited) {
                    text += ' — يتم عرض أول ' + json.data.limit + ' نتيجة فقط لتخفيف الصفحة';
                }
                setStatus(text, 'is-success');
            } else {
                setStatus('لا توجد نتائج مطابقة داخل حلقات هذا الأنمي.', 'is-success');
            }
        })
        .catch(function (err) {
            if (err && err.name === 'AbortError') {
                return;
            }

            setStatus('تعذر تنفيذ البحث الآن. جرّب مرة أخرى أو استخدم الترقيم.', 'is-error');
        });
    }

    if (searchInput && list) {
        refreshNormalSnapshot();

        searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
            var query = (searchInput.value || '').trim();

            window.clearTimeout(searchTimer);

            if (query === '') {
                restoreNormalEpisodes();
                return;
            }

            searchTimer = window.setTimeout(function () {
                runAjaxSearch(query);
            }, 350);
        });
    }

    waLoadImages(document);

    document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
        var loadMore = e.target.closest('.episodes-load-more');

        if (!loadMore) {
            return;
        }

        if (searchActive) {
            e.preventDefault();
            return;
        }

        e.preventDefault();

        if (loadMore.classList.contains('is-loading')) {
            return;
        }

        var nextUrl = loadMore.getAttribute('href');

        if (!nextUrl) {
            return;
        }

        loadMore.classList.add('is-loading');
        loadMore.textContent = 'جاري التحميل...';

        fetch(nextUrl, { credentials: 'same-origin' })
            .then(function (response) {
                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error('Request failed');
                }
                return response.text();
            })
            .then(function (html) {
                var parser = new DOMParser();
                var doc    = parser.parseFromString(html, 'text/html');

                var currentList = document.querySelector('#episodesList');
                var newCards    = doc.querySelectorAll('#episodesList .anime-card-themex');

                if (!currentList || !newCards.length) {
                    window.location.href = nextUrl;
                    return;
                }

                newCards.forEach(function (card) {
                    currentList.appendChild(card);
                });

                waLoadImages(currentList);

                var newLoadMore       = doc.querySelector('.episodes-load-more');
                var currentPagination = document.querySelector('.episodes-pagination-holder');
                var newPagination     = doc.querySelector('.episodes-pagination-holder');

                if (newPagination && currentPagination) {
                    currentPagination.innerHTML = newPagination.innerHTML;
                }

                if (newLoadMore) {
                    loadMore.setAttribute('href', newLoadMore.getAttribute('href'));
                    loadMore.setAttribute('data-current-page', newLoadMore.getAttribute('data-current-page') || '');
                    loadMore.setAttribute('data-max-pages', newLoadMore.getAttribute('data-max-pages') || '');
                    loadMore.textContent = 'عرض المزيد من الحلقات';
                    loadMore.classList.remove('is-loading');
                } else {
                    loadMore.remove();
                }

                refreshNormalSnapshot();
            })
            .catch(function () {
                window.location.href = nextUrl;
            });
    });
})();
</script>

    (function () {
        var alertBox = document.getElementById('tme-alert');
        var closeBtn = document.getElementById('tme-close');

        if (!alertBox) {
            return;
        }

        var storageKey = 'anime4up_tme_alert_last_shown';
        var twentyFourHours = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
        var now = Date.now ? Date.now() : new Date().getTime();

        function getLastShown() {
            try {
                return parseInt(localStorage.getItem(storageKey) || '0', 10) || 0;
            } catch (e) {
                return 0;
            }
        }

        function saveShownTime() {
            try {
                localStorage.setItem(storageKey, String(Date.now ? Date.now() : new Date().getTime()));
            } catch (e) {}
        }

        var lastShown = getLastShown();

        if (!lastShown || (now - lastShown) >= twentyFourHours) {
            alertBox.style.display = '';
            alertBox.classList.add('is-visible');
            saveShownTime();
        }

        if (closeBtn) {
            closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function () {
                alertBox.style.display = 'none';
                alertBox.classList.remove('is-visible');
                saveShownTime();
            });
        }
    })();
    </script>

<script id="mirai-contact-form-js-js-after">
(function(){
    document.addEventListener('submit', function(e){
      var form = e.target;
      if (!form || form.id !== 'mirai-contact-form') return;
      e.preventDefault();

      var data = new FormData(form);
      data.set('action', 'dbmovies_inboxes_form');

      var msgEl = document.getElementById('contact-response-message');
      if (msgEl) { msgEl.textContent = 'جارٍ الإرسال...'; msgEl.classList.remove('is-success','is-error'); }

      fetch(window.MIRAI_CF.ajax_url, { method: 'POST', body: data })
        .then(function(r){
          var ctype = r.headers.get('content-type') || '';
          if (ctype.indexOf('application/json') === -1) return r.text().then(function(t){ return { success:false, data:{message: t || 'استجابة غير متوقعة'} }; });
          return r.json();
        })
        .then(function(json){
          if(!msgEl) return;
          if(json && json.success){
            msgEl.classList.remove('is-error'); msgEl.classList.add('is-success');
            msgEl.textContent = (json.data && json.data.message) ? json.data.message : 'تم الإرسال بنجاح';
            form.reset();
          } else {
            msgEl.classList.remove('is-success'); msgEl.classList.add('is-error');
            msgEl.textContent = (json && json.data && json.data.message) ? json.data.message : 'حدث خطأ.';
          }
        })
        .catch(function(){
          if(msgEl){ msgEl.classList.add('is-error'); msgEl.textContent = 'تعذر الاتصال بالخادم.'; }
        });
    }, true);
  })();

    <script id="a4up-community-auth-return-js">
    (function () {
        var KEY = 'a4up_community_return_url';
        var TIME_KEY = 'a4up_community_return_time';
        var MAX_AGE = 30 * 60 * 1000;

        function setCookie(name, value, seconds) {
            document.cookie = name + '=' + encodeURIComponent(value) + '; path=/; max-age=' + seconds + '; SameSite=Lax';
        }

        function getCookie(name) {
            var parts = document.cookie ? document.cookie.split('; ') : [];
            for (var i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
                var row = parts[i].split('=');
                if (row.shift() === name) {
                    return decodeURIComponent(row.join('='));
                }
            }
            return '';
        }

        function clearReturn() {
            try {
                localStorage.removeItem(KEY);
                localStorage.removeItem(TIME_KEY);
            } catch (e) {}
            setCookie(KEY, '', 0);
        }

        function sameOrigin(url) {
            try {
                return new URL(url, window.location.origin).origin === window.location.origin;
            } catch (e) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest('a[data-a4up-community-return]') : null;
            if (!link) return;

            var returnUrl = link.getAttribute('data-a4up-community-return') || '';
            if (!returnUrl || !sameOrigin(returnUrl)) return;

            try {
                localStorage.setItem(KEY, returnUrl);
                localStorage.setItem(TIME_KEY, String(Date.now()));
            } catch (err) {}
            setCookie(KEY, returnUrl, 1800);
        }, true);

            })();

<script type="text/javascript">
if (window.jQuery) {
(function(w,d,$){ "use strict";
  /* ===== Config ===== */
  w.AjaxtURL = "https://w1.anime4up.rest/wp-content/themes/Anime4up-SEO-Continue-Watching-Fixed/Ajaxt/";
  w.LoaderVar = $('<div class="loader"><div class="sk-chase"><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div><div class="sk-chase-dot"></div></div></div>');

  /* ===== Main widgets (owl) ===== */
  $(function(){
    $('.main-widget').each(function(){
      const $w = $(this),
            $outer = $w.find('.Slider--Outer'),
            $slider = $w.find('.anime-slider'),
            $prev = $w.find('.slider-prev'),
            $next = $w.find('.slider-next');

      if (!$slider.length) return;

      $slider.owlCarousel({
        rtl: true,
        loop: false,
        margin: 12,
        mouseDrag: true,
        touchDrag: true,
        pullDrag: true,
        smartSpeed: 350,
        dots: false,
        nav: false,
        responsive: {
          '0': { items: 2 },
          '576': { items: 2 },
          '992': { items: 3 },
          '1030': { items: 5 }
        }
      });

      const update = function(){
        const api = $slider.data('owl.carousel');
        if (!api) return;

        const curr = api.relative(api.current()),
              vis = api.settings.items,
              total = api.$stage.children('.owl-item').not('.cloned').length,
              max = Math.max(0, total - vis);

        $prev.prop('disabled', curr <= 0 || total <= vis);
        $next.prop('disabled', curr >= max || total <= vis);
      };

      $prev.on('click', function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        $slider.trigger('prev.owl.carousel');
      });

      $next.on('click', function(e){
        e.preventDefault();
        $slider.trigger('next.owl.carousel');
      });

      $slider.on('initialized.owl.carousel changed.owl.carousel resized.owl.carousel refreshed.owl.carousel', update);

      setTimeout(function(){
        $outer.css({height:'auto'});
        update();
      }, 500);
    });
  });

  /* ===== Search head (instant) ===== */
  $(function(){
    const $b=$('body'), $h=$('.SearchHead'), $f=$h.find('form'), $i=$f.find('input[name="s"],input[type="text"]').first(),
          $r=$('.SearchListResult'), $in=$('.SearchInnerList'), $orig=$f, $t=$('.search--userarea--rightbar');
    const close=()=>{$h.removeClass('SearchFixed');$r.removeClass('show');$b.removeClass('SearchActive');$i.val('')};
    $i.on('input keyup',function(){
      const v=$.trim($i.val()); $h.addClass('SearchFixed'); $r.addClass('show'); $b.addClass('SearchActive'); $in.find('.SearchListMoreButton').remove();
      if(v){ $in.html(w.LoaderVar);
        $.post(w.AjaxtURL+'Searching.php',{search:v},m=>{$in.show().html(m).append(
          '<a class="SearchListMoreButton" href="https://w1.anime4up.rest/?s='+encodeURIComponent(v)+'">عرض المزيد</a>');},'html');
      }else{ $in.empty().show(); }
    });
    $(d).on('mouseup',e=>{if(!$h.is(e.target)&&!$h.has(e.target).length)$h.removeClass('Active')});
    $('header.header .SearchHead input').on('focus',()=>{$h.addClass('Active');$r.addClass('show')});
    $b.on('click','.search--toggle',()=>{$b.toggleClass('searchOn')});
    $('header.Main--Header .Header--Search input').on('focus',()=>$('.Header--Search').addClass('Active'));
    $(d).on('click','.SearchInnerList',e=>e.stopPropagation());
    $(d).on('click','.SearchListResult.show',e=>{ if($(e.target).closest('.SearchInnerList,.search--userarea--rightbar').length)return; close(); });
    $(d).on('click','.Close--SearchingBox',e=>{e.preventDefault();close()});
    const _open=d.getElementById('search_open'), _hide=d.getElementById('hideSearch');
    if(_open&&_hide){ const t=()=>{ const head=d.querySelector('.SearchHead'); head&&head.classList.toggle('open') }; _open.onclick=_hide.onclick=t; }
    const node=$h.get(0);
    if(node){ new MutationObserver(ms=>{ms.forEach(m=>{
      if($(m.target).hasClass('SearchFixed')){ if($i.length && !$t.find('input[name="s"]').length){ $i.detach().prependTo($t).focus(); } }
      else{ if($i.length && !$orig.find('input[name="s"]').length){ $i.detach().prependTo($orig); } }
    })}).observe(node,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});}
  });

  /* ===== Lazy images / backgrounds ===== */
  (function(){
    const loadImg=el=>{const s=el.dataset.image; if(!s) return; el.src=s; el.onload=()=>{el.classList.add('Loaded'); el.removeAttribute('data-image')}; el.onerror=()=>el.remove();};
    const loadBg=el=>{const s=el.dataset.src||el.dataset.bg; if(!s) return; el.style.backgroundImage=`url("${s}")`; el.classList.add('bgLoaded'); el.removeAttribute('data-src'); el.removeAttribute('data-bg');};
    let io=null;
    const onIn=ents=>ents.forEach(e=>{ if(!e.isIntersecting) return; const el=e.target; (el.tagName==='IMG'?loadImg:loadBg)(el); io&&io.unobserve(el); });
    const boot=root=>root.querySelectorAll('img.imgInit[data-image]:not([data-lzy]),.image[data-src]:not([data-lzy]),[data-bg]:not([data-lzy])')
      .forEach(el=>{el.dataset.lzy=1; io?io.observe(el):(el.tagName==='IMG'?loadImg(el):loadBg(el))});
    const init=()=>{ if('IntersectionObserver'in w) io=new IntersectionObserver(onIn,{rootMargin:'200px 0px',threshold:.1}); boot(d);
      new MutationObserver(ms=>ms.forEach(m=>{m.addedNodes&&m.addedNodes.forEach(n=>{ if(n.nodeType===1) boot(n) })})).observe(d.body,{childList:true,subtree:true});
    };
    d.readyState==='loading'?d.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',init):init();
  })();

  /* ===== Lucodeia slider - Hero slider sub-pixel fix ===== */
  $(function(){
    const $p   = $('.Slider--pind');
    const $owl = $('.owl-carousel.lucodeia-slider');

    if (!$owl.length) return;

    /*
     * سبب ظهور جزء من الصورة التالية عندك كان فرق 1px تقريبًا:
     * outer width = 1910
     * active item width = 1909
     * لذلك نثبت عرض عناصر Owl يدويًا على عرض الإطار + 2px overlap بسيط.
     */

    const injectHeroSliderCss = function(){
      if (d.getElementById('wa-hero-slider-subpixel-css')) return;

      const css = [
        '.Slider--pind{width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden!important;position:relative;}',
